# Validation fixtures

Independently derived golden records and external adapter fixtures belong in
this directory. Package-generated outputs must never be used as their own
golden expectations.

Version 0.1.0 does not include an independently derived external fixture. The
synthetic, manually calculated example exercised by the package tests is
documented in `inst/extdata/README.md`.

The DASH and HEI-2015 profiles in
`tests/testthat/helper-population-diet-fixtures.R` are synthetic, manually
constructed examples, not an independent external validation dataset.
DASH's worst and best profiles earn eight 1-point or eight 5-point components
(totals 8 and 40). The HEI-2015 worst, midpoint, and best profiles earn zero,
half, or all of each component's maximum (totals 0, 50, and 100). Expectations
are literal arithmetic values, never outputs generated by the scoring code.
Cutpoints are synthetic, not estimates from NHANES. Source locations, units,
and implementation conventions are documented in the `population-diets`
vignette and `score_le8()` reference page.
